      boolean deposit(@NotNull @NotNull QUser obj, double amount, @NotNull @NotNull org.bukkit.World world, @Nullable @Nullable String currency)

      currency - The currency name
      world - The transaction world

    • transfer

      boolean transfer(@NotNull @NotNull QUser from, @NotNull @NotNull QUser to, double amount, @NotNull @NotNull org.bukkit.World world, @Nullable @Nullable String currency)
      Transfers the given amount of money from Player1 to Player2
      Parameters:
      from - The player who is paying money, The object of one of type: UUID, OfflinePlayer, String
      to - The player who is receiving money, The object of one of type: UUID, OfflinePlayer, String
      amount - The amount to transfer
      currency - The currency name
      world - The transaction world
      Returns:
      true if success (Payer had enough cash, receiver was able to receive the funds)

      currency - The currency name
      world - The transaction world
      Returns:
      True if success, false if they didn't have enough cash
